root_cause.text: The `qfq_change_class()` function in the `sch_qfq` scheduler unconditionally freed the class structure and associated qdisc during error handling even when the class already existed, resulting in a use-after-free vulnerability.
root_cause.evidence: The patch wraps the `qdisc_put(cl->qdisc)` and `kfree(cl)` calls in the `destroy_class` label with `if (!existing)`, preventing the deallocation of pre-existing objects as explicitly warned in the CVE description regarding UAF risks when a new class is not allocated.

intent_record.intent_summary: Corrects memory management in qfq_change_class to prevent double-free errors when modifying existing classes
intent_record.what: Wrapped qdisc_put and kfree calls in the destroy_class error path with an if (!existing) condition
intent_record.how: Prevents releasing class and qdisc resources when the class already exists, avoiding potential double-free errors while ensuring cleanup for new allocations
